And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her…
He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

translations.web: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the LORD had made his journey a success.
